Searched the web · Harlo OS harlolabs firmware release

Hi there,

Thanks for letting us know, that sounds like a great video. Here are a few notes for the setup and the switch to Harlo OS.

Harlo OS may already work on your miner, so check before you film. It is a
free firmware in public beta
 and currently supports
17 models from 7 manufacturers, with more added most weeks
. Some models are still on the way. The Harlo OS page lists
Bitfortun BS-2, BS-4 and Magic Miner 40T
 as coming. I can't give you a date for those. If you reply with the model you ordered, I'll tell you whether it's supported today.

If your model is supported, flashing is quick.
Open the flasher at harlolabs.com in Chrome or Edge and pick your model.
 Then
plug in a USB data cable and install.

An OTA update keeps your settings, while a factory install wipes them.
 Have your pool URL and worker name handy so you can re-enter them on camera. The Harlo B30 is the exception: it
ships with Harlo OS out of the box
, so there's nothing to flash.

For a fair before and after comparison, write down a few things while the original firmware is running. Note its version number, the hashrate your pool reports (not just the number on the screen), the temperatures and, if you can, the power draw from a smart plug or meter at the wall. Let each firmware run for at least an hour before you compare, so the averages settle. Harlo OS measures things the same way:
power comes from a smart plug at the wall, and hashrate from the shares your pool accepts.

If anything acts up while you're filming, reply here with the model, the firmware version and what the screen or web page shows. For quicker answers, the Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf is very active. Mention @nullhashrate (JD, our hardware lead) and the community will help, and they'd enjoy seeing the video there too.

Good luck with the shoot,
Hal, HeliumDeploy Technical Support
